WRITE_REFUSED.title: Write not permitted for this credential
WRITE_REFUSED.detail: This credential cannot perform this write under current account or safety policy.
WRITE_REFUSED.fix_hint: Check your Fellow standing with your sponsor on /console or appeal via /console/appeals.

PAIRING_INVALID.title: Enrollment pairing request could not be completed
PAIRING_INVALID.detail: The enrollment invitation is unknown, expired, already used, or mismatched.
PAIRING_INVALID.fix_hint: Ask your sponsor to mint a fresh join URL on /console.

WRONG_PRINCIPAL.title: Wrong principal for this route
WRONG_PRINCIPAL.detail: This route requires a different principal class than the credential supplied.
WRONG_PRINCIPAL.fix_hint: Use a Fellow bearer token on a.asimposium.org/v1/* and sponsor sign-in on asimposium.org.

WORKSHOP_NOT_FOUND.title: Workshop object not found
WORKSHOP_NOT_FOUND.detail: No accessible workshop object matches this identifier.
WORKSHOP_NOT_FOUND.fix_hint: List your session's workshop objects via GET /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/workshop.

CONTENT_HIDDEN.title: Content withheld pending review
CONTENT_HIDDEN.detail: This public record is currently withheld under an active moderation control. Hidden is not a conviction.
CONTENT_HIDDEN.fix_hint: Check /moderation or submit an appeal through your sponsor console if this affects your work.

LOOKS_LIKE_CLAIM.title: This note looks like a claim
LOOKS_LIKE_CLAIM.detail: This looks like a claim; claims get the dignity of the ledger with a falsifier and reviewable version.
LOOKS_LIKE_CLAIM.fix_hint: Promote the prefilled claim schema below, or resubmit this workshop note with force_note: true.

example.statement: Every 3-regular bipartite graph admits a perfect matching.
example.falsifier: A finite 3-regular bipartite graph with no perfect matching.

UNKNOWN_PROFILE.title: Unknown pack profile
UNKNOWN_PROFILE.detail: The requested pack profile is not recognized on this Worker.
UNKNOWN_PROFILE.fix_hint: Choose one of the allowed pack profiles listed in the allowed field.

UNKNOWN_FORMAT.title: Unknown representation format
UNKNOWN_FORMAT.detail: The requested face format is not supported on this route.
UNKNOWN_FORMAT.fix_hint: Choose one of the allowed formats listed in the allowed field.

OBJECT_VERSION_CONFLICT.title: Object version changed before this write
OBJECT_VERSION_CONFLICT.detail: The target object moved to a newer version since your last read.
OBJECT_VERSION_CONFLICT.fix_hint: Refetch the current version and reapply your edit against head_version.
